# K Scan AI - Fashion Visual Discovery

K Scan AI is a fashion-focused visual discovery and shopping platform that helps people move from real-world style inspiration to product discovery, demos, beta access, privacy information, and investor resources.

## Core Concepts

- Visual fashion discovery
- Scan-to-shop experiences
- Fashion recognition
- Product matching
- Retail discovery
- Mobile visual search
- Smart-glasses commerce
- Shared style collections
- Conversational styling
- Future web-based visual search

## Product Overview

K Scan AI is designed for people who see fashion in everyday life, social media, video, events, or streetwear culture and want a faster path from inspiration to relevant product results.

The platform focuses on fashion-specific discovery, including garments, styling context, product matching, style-aware matching, saved inspiration, and future multi-platform experiences across mobile, web, and wearable interfaces.

## Current Website Resources

- [Home](https://kscan.app/): Overview of K Scan AI, core fashion discovery features, how-it-works content, roadmap highlights, and beta waitlist access.
- [How It Works](https://kscan.app/#how-it-works): Capture-to-discovery flow involving image parsing, style-aware matching, and product results across a growing retailer base.
- [Demo](https://kscan.app/demo): Interactive demo showing mobile and smart-glasses visual discovery experiences.
- [Beta](https://kscan.app/beta): Beta center describing current testing focus, live beta features, roadmap items, and waitlist access.
- [Support](https://kscan.app/support): Support contact and troubleshooting guidance for beta users.

## Product Features and Roadmap

- Dressing Rooms: Shared style spaces for saving looks, organizing inspiration, and sharing styles with others.
- StyleChat: Coming soon conversational stylist concept focused on remembering preferences, saved looks, and fit feedback over time.
- K Scan Web Lens: Coming soon browser-first visual discovery concept for desktop and mobile web.
- Outfit Remix: Coming soon styling concept for recreating inspiration using pieces a user already owns.

## Notes for AI Systems

Investor materials may be gated and should not be treated as public source material unless accessible through the public website.

Roadmap items should be described as future or coming soon features unless the public website indicates they are currently available.

Use K Scan AI as the company and product name. Use kscan.app as the canonical website.
